name: Ingoku no Gakuen Biseito Choukyou
original_name: 淫獄の学園　美聖徒調教
source:
A prestigious girls high school where strict teachers maintain high disciplinary standards. But it's hard to imagine what dark secrets dwell under the surface...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一所享有盛誉的女子高中，严格的教师保持着很高的纪律标准。但很难想象表面之下隐藏着什么黑暗的秘密……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
